verses.1:
When I heal Israel,
 the iniquity of Ephraim + 7:1 That is, the northern kingdom of Israel; also in verses 8 and 11 will be exposed,
 as well as the crimes of Samaria.
 For they practice deceit and thieves break in;
 bandits raid in the streets.
verses.2:
But they fail to consider in their hearts
 that I remember all their evil.
 Now their deeds are all around them;
 they are before My face.
verses.3:
They delight the king with their evil,
 and the princes with their lies.
verses.4:
They are all adulterers,
 like an oven heated by a baker
 who needs not stoke the fire
 from the kneading to the rising of the dough.
verses.5:
The princes are inflamed with wine
 on the day of our king;
 so he joins hands
 with those who mock him.
verses.6:
For they prepare their heart like an oven
 while they lie in wait;
 all night their anger smolders; + 7:6 Literally their baker sleeps 
 in the morning it blazes like a flaming fire.
verses.7:
All of them are hot as an oven,
 and they devour their rulers.
 All their kings fall;
 not one of them calls upon Me.
verses.8:
Ephraim mixes with the nations;
 Ephraim is an unturned cake.
verses.9:
Foreigners consume his strength,
 but he does not notice.
 Even his hair is streaked with gray,
 but he does not know.
verses.11:
So Ephraim has become like a silly, senseless dove —
 calling out to Egypt, then turning to Assyria.
verses.12:
As they go, I will spread My net over them;
 I will bring them down like birds of the air.
 I will chastise them
 when I hear them flocking together. + 7:12 Or I will chastise them according to what was reported against them in the assembly.
verses.13:
Woe to them, for they have strayed from Me!
 Destruction to them, for they have rebelled against Me!
 Though I would redeem them,
 they speak lies against Me.
verses.14:
They do not cry out to Me from their hearts
 when they wail upon their beds.
 They slash themselves + 7:14 Some Hebrew manuscripts and LXX; see 1 Kings 18:28|1KI 18:28 . Most Hebrew manuscripts They gather together for grain and new wine,
 but turn away from Me.
verses.15:
Although I trained and strengthened their arms,
 they plot evil against Me.

metadata.source: Derived from the Berean Standard Bible (BSB). Missing verses restored from the Textus Receptus tradition for completeness.
